title: Publishing extensions
subtitle: Import site themes and publishing styles, review permissions, and manage installed versions.
fileHint: Choose a package from a trusted author (up to 12 MB). Files stay in this dialog until you review and install.
activationHint: Changing the default does not rewrite project selections. Disabling blocks new builds; already accepted builds keep their frozen inputs.
executionNotice: Executable themes can read the frozen site content inside an isolated build. Install only code you trust. Packages cannot choose host commands, image registries or credentials.
acceptPermissions: I approve these permissions for this exact package version and digest.
noPackages: No third-party packages installed. Built-in themes and skills remain available.
readyForReview: Review the package identity and permissions before installing.
invalidPackage: The package format or a required field is invalid.
packageTooLarge: The package exceeds the supported size limits.
unsupportedPermission: This package requests a permission that this version does not support.
permissionMismatch: The declared permissions do not match the package exports.
incompatibleEngine: This package requires a different engine version.
invalidPackagePath: A package file path is unsafe, ambiguous or outside its declared theme root.
packageDigestMismatch: The package files do not match their recorded hashes.
registryConflict: The installed packages changed. Refresh, then review the current package state again.
immutableVersion: This ID and version already have different contents. Publish a new package version.
packageNotInstalled: This package version is not installed.
packageUnavailable: The package or its stored files are temporarily unavailable.
reviewChanged: The package changed after review. Review the current file again.
approvalRequired: Approve the exact package permissions before installing.
unsupportedSchema: This package registry was created by a newer PandaForce version.
crossOrigin: The package operation was rejected because the request came from another origin.
identityRequired: Sign in with the PandaForce administrator account or your configured identity provider to manage packages.
permissionCode: Run approved theme code inside isolated builds
librarySubtitle: Maintain drafts, fixed samples and immutable version archives.
libraryExportsHint: Edit the supported exports, formats, labels and declarative styles as JSON. Identity and version are maintained above.
libraryMatrixHint: Edit the complete sample matrix as JSON, then save to load its changes. Every exported theme and channel format needs coverage.
libraryRequiresBuild: Requires an approved isolated site build
libraryDiscardHint: You have unsaved changes. Keep editing or discard them before leaving this draft.
librarySelect: Select a draft or create a publishing style.
libraryDeleteHint: Remove this working copy? Published version archives remain available.
libraryValidationHint: Preview each fixed sample, accept its baseline, then validate all exported formats.
invalidLibraryDraft: This style draft is invalid. Check its archive, package, and sample definitions.
libraryNotFound: This style draft, sample, or archive was not found.
libraryConflict: This draft changed. Reload its latest revision before continuing.
libraryPublished: This version is immutable. Create a new version draft to edit it.
libraryUnverified: Review baselines and pass all required checks before publishing this version.
libraryStorageFull: Publishing style storage is full. Remove unused working copies before continuing.
stylesHint: Compare website themes and channel layouts. Manage their versions, previews, and packages.
stylesEmpty: No matching styles. Import a package or adjust your filters.
stylesVersionHint: Projects keep their selected versions. Editing a copy or installing an upgrade does not change an existing publication.
stylesChannelSample: Fixed sample, rendered by the publishing formatter. Plain text and X formats do not preserve font or color styling.
stylesSiteSample: The initial view illustrates typography and color. Build a website preview to inspect the actual engine output.
stylesExported: Package exported. It contains no project documents or connection credentials.
stylesBuiltinSite: Copy this built-in website profile to customize it. Existing projects keep their selected version.
stylesCodeTheme: This theme contains engine code. Inspect its files in package management, then build a publishing space for a complete preview.
stylesSampleIntro: Compare typography, spacing and color before choosing a website theme.
stylesSampleHeading: From a thought to a useful document
stylesSampleBody: Start with a clear question. Add evidence, preserve context and give the reader a next step.
stylesSampleQuote: A useful document keeps its meaning when it travels.
stylesFieldsInvalid: Correct the layout JSON to use the visual style controls.
sampleBusy: Too many website samples are running. Wait for a sample to finish and try again.
sampleConflict: This website sample request changed. Refresh the theme and try again.
sampleNotFound: This website sample is unavailable for your account.
sampleArtifactUnavailable: This website sample output is unavailable or has expired. Build the sample again.
sampleReady: No website sample has been built for these settings.
sampleReviewHint: Review and install this exact theme package before building a sample. This does not archive the style or publish an article.
sampleThemeReviewed: The theme package is approved. You can now build its website sample.
declarativeNotice: This package contains appearance settings and adds no executable theme code.
exportUnavailable: This resource is not installed or has been disabled. Review and install it before use.
settingsHint: Manage site themes and publishing styles. Creation skills have their own workspace.
settingsSkillsHint: Browse and manage skills for writing, slides, images and more.
settingsPublishingHint: Manage channels and publishing destinations, then choose a theme or style.
settingsInstalledHint: Packages add site themes and channel formatting styles.
settingsLoadFailed: Could not load extensions. Check your connection and try Refresh.
settingsEmptyHint: Built-in themes and styles are ready to use. Import a package from a trusted author to add more.
settingsStepImportHint: Choose a JSON package, up to 12 MB.
settingsStepReviewHint: Check its contents and requested permissions.
settingsStepUseHint: Choose a theme or style for a publishing destination.
settingsThemes: {count, plural, one {# site theme} other {# site themes}}
settingsStyles: {count, plural, one {# publishing style} other {# publishing styles}}
settingsVersions: {count, plural, one {# installed version} other {# installed versions}}
